scope: Existing artifacts only, no score re-audit or new runs.

critical_path_partition.basis: Mailman is the latest finishing trial; partition suite wall around its agent phase. These mutually exclusive intervals sum exactly.

tasks.non_api_residual_definition: Tool execution/poll waits plus parsing, formatting, tmux/control IO and other host work; not independently instrumented.

coverage.reason: All calls have client request duration/usage. Device generation, network/queue/prefill/decode splits, actual tool durations and standalone parser CPU times are absent; cannot assert95% fine-grained runtime attribution.

source_basis.request_measurement: _query_llm lines1217-1224 times await chat.chat; chronological successful requests are appended. No summarization; call counts match episode counts.
source_basis.episode_measurement: step timestamps follow parse feedback on errors or command execution on normal steps, lines1585/1720. Differences are episode windows, not request timestamps.
source_basis.usage: metrics are chat token-counter deltas; per-step totals exactly match task and trajectory totals.

missing_fields: Exact raw chat request messages and prompt/completion token IDs; structured parsed analysis/plan, reasoning and commands are not a lossless serialized request.

interpretation: Summed agent/request seconds span two concurrent agents and must not be added to suite wall or treated as device hours.
